summary: Parse one standard EFIT G-EQDSK equilibrium file into named arrays with grid coordinates.

capability: Load a tokamak equilibrium g-file: poloidal flux map psi(R,Z), F(psi), p(psi), q(psi), boundary and limiter.
operation: G-EQDSK text -> dictionary of scalars, flux-grid profiles, psi(R,Z) and R, Z grids
discovery.model: EFIT G-EQDSK record layout (Lao 1997): (6a8,3i4) first record, 5e16.9 real records, 2i5 boundary/limiter counts.
discovery.geometry: Rectangular NW by NH grid: R from RLEFT to RLEFT+RDIM, Z from ZMID-ZDIM/2 to ZMID+ZDIM/2; profiles on NW uniform flux points from SIMAG to SIBRY.
discovery.boundary: Values are returned as written: units are the specification's (m, Wb/rad, m T, Pa, A, T); no COCOS sign convention is inferred and no flux-surface quantity is computed.

identity.relation: Deterministic deserialization of standard EFIT G-EQDSK records
identity.definition: First record: 48-character description, then integers with NW and NH last; four scalar records (RDIM ZDIM RCENTR RLEFT ZMID / RMAXIS ZMAXIS SIMAG SIBRY BCENTR / CURRENT and repeats); FPOL, PRES, FFPRIM, PPRIME (NW each); PSIRZ (NW*NH, R index fastest); QPSI (NW); NBBBS, LIMITR; boundary and limiter (R,Z) pairs
identity.model: EFIT G-EQDSK record layout from the published format specification.
identity.geometry: psirz[j, i] is the flux at (r[i], z[j]); r and z are uniform; psi is the uniform flux grid of the profiles
identity.coordinates: Cylindrical (R, Z) in m; flux per radian; signs as written in the file
identity.boundary: No COCOS inference, no consistency check between the repeated header values, no equilibrium reconstruction or interpolation.
assumptions: Numbers appear in specification order; each value is a Fortran real with optional E or D exponent
Fields may run together when a value starts with a minus sign
NW and NH are the last two integers of the first record

inputs.name: strict
inputs.description: Reject numbers after the limiter section
inputs.constraints: False ignores appended records but still requires every standard record

outputs.name: mapping
outputs.description: Specification-named scalars, profiles fpol/pres/ffprim/pprime/qpsi, psirz (nh, nw), r, z, psi, boundary rbbbs/zbbbs and limiter rlim/zlim
outputs.units: m, Wb/rad, m T, N/m^2, A, T as in the specification
outputs.constraints: Finite values; positive RDIM, ZDIM; SIMAG differs from SIBRY

preconditions: Standard EFIT G-EQDSK text with at least two grid points in R and Z
supported: Fixed-width 5e16.9 records including fields joined by a minus sign
Free-format whitespace-separated numbers and D exponents
excluded: The extended SciRel dialect read by read_eqdsk

failure_semantics.invalid_input: EQDSKFormatError for a missing, truncated, non-numeric or non-finite record, a non-integer count, non-positive RDIM or ZDIM, equal SIMAG and SIBRY, or extra numbers when strict.
failure_semantics.partial_results: None; a failed read returns nothing.

example.description: Write a 3-by-2 G-EQDSK file by hand and read the flux at R index 2, Z index 1.
example.code:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import numpy as np
from scirel.io import read_geqdsk
rec = lambda v: [''.join('%16.9E' % x for x in v[i:i+5]) for i in range(0, len(v), 5)]
lines = ['EXAMPLE'.ljust(48) + '   0   3   2']
for values in ([2., 3., 1.5, .25, 0.], [1.2, 0., -.75, .5, -2.5], [1e6, -.75, 0., 1.2, 0.], [0., 0., .5, 0., 0.]):
    lines += rec(values)
for _ in range(4):
    lines += rec([1., 2., 3.])
lines += rec([11., 21., 31., 12., 22., 32.]) + rec([1., 2., 3.]) + ['    0    0']
with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    path = Path(directory) / 'g.eqdsk'
    path.write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
    g = read_geqdsk(path)
    assert g['psirz'].shape == (2, 3) and g['psirz'][1, 2] == 32.0
    assert np.allclose(g['r'], [.25, 1.25, 2.25]) and np.allclose(g['z'], [-1.5, 1.5])

scope: Hand-written records following the published layout: scalar positions, profile and flux-map order, grids, boundary and limiter, joined fields, free format, strict trailing policy and malformed input
verification.evidence_ceiling: Structural I/O only; no physical interpretation or sign convention is claimed.
known_limitations: COCOS and sign conventions are not inferred
Repeated header values are not cross-checked
Some writers deviate from the layout (for example wider integer fields); such files may need strict=False or fail

references: L. L. Lao, G EQDSK FORMAT, 7 February 1997, EFIT format specification.
